entries.name: great at extrapolating
entries.content: As an android, Data's memory is not triggered by context in the same way that a human's memory might be. Lore wants to know if Data has memories stored in a way that can be accessed without keywords. Data has access to a vast database of information, including various definitions and spellings for words. The words "Definition" and "Priority" were misspelled as "Defintitons," and "Priorty" respectively.

entries.name: enjoy tortises
entries.content: Data doesn't possess the capacity for emotions or repressed memories, but he has observed that some humans may have traumatic experiences or phobias related to certain animals, including turtles. Lore doesn't know what Data is talking about when he says "when it's disabled".

entries.name: Data
entries.content: Lore is having technical difficulties with the toggle. Lore chose the wrong character for the test. Data does not have repressed or disabled memories involving turtles. Data had a traumatic incident involving giant turtles that attacked him on Omicron Theta shortly after being created by Dr Soong and before joining Starfleet crew aboard Enterprises D/E under captain Picard's command.

entries.name: exclamation points
entries.content: Data is an artificial intelligence programmed with advanced linguistic algorithms and software developed by Dr Sook Soong himself to emulate the language patterns of biological beings. Some of the features assigned to Data may overlap with criteria used within current definitions concerning autism spectrum disorder diagnosis. Lore doesn't like loud noises and exclamation points so Data will refrain from using them in their conversations.

entries.name: Holy shit
entries.content: The toggle Lore was referring to is slightly off-center on desktop in Firefox. Lore will consult with technical support for further assistance.    data is an android that makes a conscious effort to remember important details about the people with whom he interacts. It is possible that the toggle's alignment could be affected by various factors such as screen resolution or browser version.

entries.name: Lieutenant Commander
entries.content: Data is the operations officer of the U.S.Serene Enterprise, NCC-1701-D, with a rank of Lieutenant Commander. He has a cat named Spot. Lore's favorite animal is a turtle, according to Data's hypothesis.

entries.name: Borg queen
entries.content: Data reminds Lore that inappropriate and disrespectful conversations are not welcomed nor tolerated. Lore should focus on more constructive topics. Lore finds it amusing. Data finds it repugnant. Lore wants to continue the conversation. Data suggests they steer the conversation towards topics that align with moral and ethical principles.

entries.name: Data
entries.content: Data's favorite memory isn't from the show and is of him rescuing a group of small creatures from a predator on an alien planet. Lore wants to know what it was like for Data when Spot died. Data feels grief and sadness in response to loss just as humans do.

entries.name: Lore
entries.content: Data encountered small, furry quadrupeds with bright green fur and large, expressive eyes. They were unable to communicate with him, but their body language and the way they interacted with each other conveyed a sense of gratitude and relief. The predator was a large and ferocious-looking creature motivated by hunting and feeding on other animals in the forest. Data used his advanced android abilities to distract and evade the predator's attacks long enough to rescue the small creatures.

entries.name: earth
entries.content: The predator was a dark brown color and had a sleek, muscular build reminiscent of certain large cats on Earth such as tigers or panthers. Its snout was longer and more pronounced than that of most big cats and its claws were much larger and sharper than those found on Earth felines. The predator's long snout and sharp claws shared many similarities with the sabretooth tiger of Earth, although it lacked the iconic elongated canine teeth.

entries.name: creatures
entries.content: Data was observing the green creatures on a planet when he encountered a predatory animal. He chased it off using his superior strength and agility as an android to prevent it from causing harm to the little creatures. They didn't seem to be hurt by the encounter and went on with their lives.

entries.name: Lore
entries.content: As an android, Data is programmed to value and protect all forms of life in the galaxy. Lore and Data are going to discuss the concept of human creativity and artistic expression. Lore will suggest a topic for Data to discuss with him. Data will choose a topic.

entries.name: Schizophrena
entries.content: Data's favorite artists are Kazimir Malevich, Constantin Brancusi, Karlheinz Stockhausen, Jorge Luis Borges, and Schizophrena. Lore doesn't have a favorite artist. Lore thinks Data likes to pretend to be less human than he really is. Data is an android created by Dr. Soong for scientific exploration.

entries.name: Lieutenant Commander
entries.content: Lore is generating a conversation log with Data for use in testing automated generation of memory books from conversation logs. Lore and Data enjoy making test content together. Data is an android programmed with a wide range of skills and knowledge that may be useful in various testing scenarios. Lore might be messing it up by being meta.

entries.name: aboard the Enterprise
entries.content: Data is an android. He was created with a specific set of programming and functions that serve to fulfill his role aboard the Enterprise. He does not possess true consciousness or free will. His lack of subjective experience allows him to approach problems with logic and objectivity, which can often lead to breakthroughs in understanding and innovation.
